note: NV-Reason-CT as a third AI reader (shown only, never counted by the checklist). Unlike MedGemma and Hulu-Med, this model reads the scan file itself as one 3D block, so it is asked in its own documented way: one structured report and one yes/no question per condition. The checklist-shaped answer file is ASSEMBLED by our code from those yes/no answers; the model never writes JSON.

representation.name: nvreason_native_3d
representation.built_by: the model's own processor (processor.py ImageLoader3D), not lung_ct.vlm.ct_representation
representation.steps: load NIfTI with MONAI (header slope/intercept applied) -> reorient to LPS from the affine -> resample to 2 mm isotropic, bilinear -> pad with -1000 HU to at least 192 voxels -> crop 192 x 192 x 192 (384 mm): centred in-plane, centred on the detected lungs head-to-foot -> clip to -1000..1000 HU and divide by 1000
representation.note: Left / right comes from the file's affine. Only scans whose left / right was verified from anatomy in the QC run are eligible. Anything outside the 384 mm cube is not seen by the model; the amount cut away is recorded per case.

report.prompt: write a structured chest CT report

questions.presence_template: Is {phrase} present in this CT? Answer only Yes or No.
questions.side_template: Which side is affected by {phrase}: right, left or both? Answer only Right, Left or Both.
questions.side_note: The presence wording is the model card's own example. The side wording is ours (the model card gives no side example); it is asked only when the answer was Yes and the condition has a side.

prompt.note: schema of the assembled answer file only

assembled_answer.status: Yes -> present, No -> absent. Any other answer is a recorded failure for the case; nothing is guessed. The model is never offered 'cannot tell'.
assembled_answer.assessability: not asked of the model; written as 'assessable' and stated under limitations
